story.iWant: AI to generate platform-optimized social media posts in real-time
story.soThat: I can immediately use content tailored for YouTube, Twitter, and LinkedIn
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create Generation Panel UI component (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Task 2: Add generation state to aiStore (AC: 9) - Task 3: Create platform-specific system prompts (AC: 5, 8) - Task 4: Create content generation service (AC: 4, 9, 10) - Task 5: Implement streaming chunk processing (AC: 10) - Task 6: Add IPC handler for generation (AC: 4, 10) - Task 7: Build user messages for GPT (AC: 7) - Task 8: Implement parallel generation (AC: 9) - Task 9: Add comprehensive error handling (AC: 11) - Task 10: Implement retry logic (AC: 11) - Task 11: Add validation in GenerationPanel (AC: 3, 7) - Task 12: Trigger generation on button click (AC: 4) - Task 13-15: Write tests for prompts, service, and integration (Testing)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Generate tab shows platform checkboxes: YouTube, Twitter, LinkedIn (multi-select) 2. "Include Emojis" toggle checkbox (default: off) 3. "Generate Posts" button enabled when at least one platform selected 4. Main process service calls GPT-4o-mini API with streaming enabled 5. System prompts crafted per platform (YouTube: SEO descriptions, Twitter: 280 char hooks, LinkedIn: professional 1-3 paragraphs) 6. Selected voice personas blended into system prompt 7. Transcription and/or user guidance included in prompt if checked 8. Emoji setting explicitly instructed in system prompts 9. Parallel generation: All selected platforms generate simultaneously 10. Streaming responses sent via IPC to renderer as chunks arrive 11. Error handling for API failures, rate limits, and network issues

docs.doc: Defines content-generator.service.ts for GPT-4o-mini streaming integration with parallel platform generation and GenerationPanel.tsx for UI controls.
Specifies IPC handler ai-generate-posts for generation orchestration with streaming events ai-stream-chunk.

artifact.reason: State management for selectedPlatforms, includeEmojis, generationStatus
Integrated into GenerationPanel for persona selection (Story 6.5)
Retrieve API key for GPT-4o-mini authentication

package.name: openai
package.reason: OpenAI SDK for GPT-4o-mini API with streaming support

story-context.constraints: - Streaming Architecture: GPT-4o-mini streams via SSE, chunks sent to renderer via IPC events ai-stream-chunk - Parallel Execution: Each platform generates concurrently using Promise.all/Promise.allSettled - System Prompts: Platform-specific prompts (YouTube: SEO, Twitter: 280 char, LinkedIn: professional) with persona blending and emoji settings - Validation: At least one platform selected, at least one input (transcription or guidance) - Error Handling: Handle API failures, rate limits, network issues with retry logic (max 2 retries, exponential backoff) - IPC Events: ai-stream-chunk with payload {platform, content, complete}
story-context.interfaces:
<interface name="IPC: ai-generate-posts" kind="ipc-channel" signature="(request: GenerationRequest) => Promise<IPCResponse<{success: boolean}>>" path="src/main/ipc/ai.handlers.ts"> Orchestrates content generation for selected platforms with streaming chunks via IPC events
Streams content chunks to renderer as GPT-4o-mini generates text
Builds YouTube system prompt with SEO optimization and emoji/persona settings
Builds Twitter system prompt with 280 char limit and emoji/persona settings
Builds LinkedIn system prompt with professional tone and emoji/persona settings

tests.standards: Unit tests for system prompts and content generation service with mocked OpenAI SDK. Integration tests for IPC flow with mocked streaming. Test parallel generation, error handling, retry logic.
tests.ideas: - AC 1-3: Test GenerationPanel renders checkboxes, button enabled when platform selected - AC 4: Test GPT-4o-mini API called with stream=true - AC 5: Test system prompts for each platform (YouTube, Twitter, LinkedIn) - AC 6: Test persona prompt injection into system prompts - AC 7: Test transcription/guidance included in user message - AC 8: Test emoji setting in system prompts (include vs exclude) - AC 9: Test parallel generation (Promise.all) for multiple platforms - AC 10: Test streaming chunks emitted via IPC events - AC 11: Test error handling (API failures, rate limits, network errors, retry logic)
